m: वैष्णावरुण mf(ई)n. (prob. for वैष्णववरुण) belonging to Viṣṇu and Varuṇa, TS.
वैष्णवाभिधान n. N. of wk. (containing the names of the disciples of Caitanya).

s: puM, (vEzRavAnAmAcAraH .) vizRuBaktAnAmAcaraRam । yaTA, -- “aTAcArA bahuviDAH SizwAcArAnusArataH । SrIvEzRavAnAM karttavyA liKyante'tra samAsataH ॥” aTAcArAH SrIvizRupurARe OrvvasagarasaMvAde gfhasTAcArakaTanAramBe । “devagobrAhmaRAn sidDAn vfdDAcAryyAMstaTArccayet । dvikalaYca namet sanDyAmagnInupacarettaTA ॥ sadAnupahate vastre praSastASca taTOzaDIH । gAruqAni ca ratnAni viBfyAt prayato naraH ॥ prasidDAmalakeSaSca suganDiScAruveSaDfk । kiYcit parasvaM na haret nAlpamapyapriyaM vadet । priyaYca nAnftaM brUyAnnAnyadozAnudIrayet । nAnyASrayaM taTA vEraM rocayet puruzeSvaraH ॥ na duzwayAnamArohet kulacCAyAM na saMSrayet । vidbizwapatitonmattabahuvErAtikIwakEH ॥ banDakIbanDakIBarttfkzudrAnftakaTEH saha । taTAtivyayaSIlESca parivAdaratEH SaWEH ॥ buDo mEtrIM na kurvvIta nEkaH panTAnamASrayet । nAvagAhejjalOGasya vegamagre janeSvara ॥ pradIptaM veSma na viSennArohecCiKaraM taroH । na kuryyAddantasaNGarzaM na kfzRIyAcca nAsikAm । nAsaMvftamuKo jfmBet SvAsakAsO vivarjjayet । noccErhaset saSabdaYca na muYcet pavanaM tvaDaH ॥ naKAnna vAdayecCindyAnna tfRaM na mahIM liKet । na SmaSru BakzayellozwrAnna gfhRIyAdvicakzaRaH ॥ jyotIMzyameDyASastAni nABivIkzeta ca praBo । na huNkuryyAcCavaM cEva SavaganDo hi somajaH ॥ catuzpaTaM cEtyataruM SmaSAnopavanAni ca । duzwastrIsannikarzaYca varjjayenniSi sarvvadA ॥ pUjyadevadbijajyotiSCAyAM nAtikramedbuDaH । nEkaH SUnyAwavIM gacCenna ca SUnyaM gfhaM vrajet ॥ keSAsTikaRWakAmeDyabaliBasmatuzAMstaTA । snAnArdrAM DaraRIM cEva dUrataH parivarjjayet ॥ nAnAryyAnASrayet kAMScinna jihmaM rocayedbuDaH । upasarpenna ca vyAlAMSciraM tizWenna cotTitaH ॥ yaTezwaBojakAMScEva taTA devaparANmuKAn । varRASramakriyAtItAn dUrataH parivarjjayet ॥ atIvajAgarasvapnO tadbat sTAnAsane buDaH । na seveta taTA SayyAM vyAyAmaYca nareSvara ॥ daMzwriRaH SfNgiRaScEva prAjYo dUreRa varjjayet । avaSyAyaYca rAjendra purovAtAtapO taTA ॥ na snAyAnna svapennagno na cevopaspfSedbuDaH । muktakacCaSca nAcAmeddevAdyarccAYca varjjayet ॥ nEkavastraH pravartteta dvijavAcanake jape ॥” * ॥ kiYca । “na ca nirDUnayet keSAnnAcAmennEva cotTitaH । pAdena nAkramet pAdaM na pUjyABimuKaM nayet ॥ apasavyaM nEva gacCeddevAgAracatuzpaTAn । maNgalyapUjyAMSca taTA viparItAnna dakziRAm ॥ somArkAgnyambuvAyUnAM pUjyAnAYca na saMmuKam । kuryyAt zWIvanaviRmUtrasamutsargaYca paRqitaH ॥ tizWanna mUtrayettadvat panTAnaM nAvamUtrayet । SlezmaviRmUtraraktAni sarvvadEva na laNGayet ॥ SlezmazWIvanakotsargo nAnnakAle praSasyate । valimaNgalajapyAdO na home na mahAjane ॥ yozito nAvamanyeta na cAsAM viSvasedbuDaH । na cEverzI BavettAsu nADikuryyAt kadAcana ॥ maNgalyapuzparatnAjyapUjyAnanaBivAdya ca । na nizkrAmet gfhAt prAjYaH sadAcAraparo naraH ॥ AkAlagarjjitAdO tu parvvasvaSOcakAdizu । anaDyAyaM buDaH kuryyAduparAgAdike taTA ॥ varzAtapAdike cCatrI daRqI rAtryawavIzu ca । SarIratrARakAmo vE sopAnatkaH sadA vrajet ॥ nordDaM na tiryyak dUraM vA nirIkzan paryyawedbuDaH । yugamAtraM mahIpfzWaM naro gacCedbilokayan ॥” * ॥ kiYca । “priyamuktaM hitaM nEtaditi matvA na tadvadet । SreyastadrahitaM vAcyaM yadyapyatyantamapriyam ॥ prARinAmupakArAya yadeveha paratra ca । karmmaRA manasA vAcA tadeva matimAn Bajet ॥” * ॥ bfhannAradIye sadAcAraprasaNge । “asAvahamiti brUyAddvijo vE hyaBivAdane । SrAdDaM vrataM japaM dAnaM devatAByarccanaM taTA ॥ yajYaYca tarpaRaYcEva kurvvantaM nABivAdayet । taTA snAnaM prakurvvantaM DAvantamaSucintaTA ॥ BuYjAnaYca SayAnaYca aByaktaSirasantaTA । BikzAnnaDAriRaM cEva ramantaM jalamaDyagam ॥ kftABivAdano yo na kuryyAt pratyaBivAdanam । nABivAdyaH sa vijYeyo yaTA SUdrastaTEva saH ॥” * mArkaRqeyapurARe madAlasAlarkasaMvAde । “asatpralApamanftaM vAkpAruzyaYca varjjayet । asacCAstramasadvAdamasatsevAYca puttraka ॥ keSaprasADanAdarSadarSanaM dantaDAvanam । pUrccAhRa eva kAryyARi devatAnAYca tarpaRam ॥ udakyAdarSanaM sparSaM varjet saBAzaRaM taTA । na cABIkzRaM SiraHsnAnaM kuryyAnnizkAraRaM naraH ॥ SiraHsnAtaSca tElena nANgaM kiYcidapi spfSet । panTA deyo brAhmaRAnAM rAjYo duHKAturasya ca ॥ vidyADikasya gurvviRyA BArArttasya mahIyasaH । mUkAnpavaDirARAYca mattasyonmattakasya ca ॥ puScalyAH kftavErasya bAlasya patitasya ca । upAnadbastramAlyAni DftAnyanyErna DArayet ॥ upavItamalaNkAraM karakaYcEva varjayet । na kziptabAhujaNGaSca prAjYastizWet kadAcana ॥ na cApi vikzipet pAdO vAsasI na ca DUnayet । mUrKonmattavyasanino virUpAn mAyinastaTA ॥ nyUnANgAnaDamAMScEva nopahAsenna dUzayet । parasya daRqaM nodyacCet SikzArTaM puttraSizyayoH ॥ nAnulepanamAdadyAdasnAtaH snAtakI kvacit । na cApi raktavAsAH syAccitravAsaDaro'pi vA ॥ kzurakarmmARi cAnte ca strIsamBoge ca puttraka । snAyIta tElavAn prAjYaH kawaBUmimupetya ca । yugapajjalamagniYca viBfyAnna vicakzaRaH ॥” kawamUmiM SmaSAnam । “nAcakzIta DayantIM gAM jalaM nAYjalinA pibet ॥” DayantIM pibantIm । “SOcakAlezu sarvvezu guruzvalpezu vA punaH । na vilambeta SOcArTaM na muKenAnalaM Damet ॥ vipruzo makzikAdyASca duzwasaNgAdadoziRaH । ajASvO muKato meDyO na gorvvatsasya cAnanam ॥ mAtuH prasnavane meDyaM SakuniH PalapAtane । udakyASOcilagnAMSca sUtikAntyAvasAyinaH । spfzwvA snAyIta SOcArTaM taTEva mftahAriRaH ॥ nAraM spfzwvAsTi sasnehaM snAtaH SuDyati mAnavaH । AcamyEva tu niHsnehaM gAmAlaByArkamIkzya vA ॥ na cAlapet janaM dbizwaM vIrahInAM taTA striyam ॥ devatAtiTisacCAstrayajYasidDAdinindakEH । kftvA tu sparSanAlApaM SudDyedarkAvalokanAt ॥ avalokya taTodakyAmantyajAn patitaM SaWam । viDarmmisUtikAzaRqavivastrAntyAvasAyinaH ॥ mftaniryAtakAScEva paradAraratASca ye । etadeva hi karttavyaM prAjYEH SoDanamAtmanaH ॥” * ॥ kiYca । “yaccApi kurvvato nAtmA jugupsAmeti puttraka । tat karttavyamaSaNkena yanna gopyaM mahAjane ॥” * ॥ Bavizyottare SrIkfzRayuDizWirasaMvAde । “upAsate na ye pUrvvAM dvijAH sanDyAM na paScimAm । sarvvAMstAn DArmmiko rAjA SUdrakarmmaRi yojayet ॥ dUrAdAvasaTAnmUtraM dUrAt pAdAvasecanam । ucCizwotsarjjanaM BUpa sadA kAryyaM hitEziRA ॥ ucCizwo na spfSecCIrzaM sarvve prARAstadASrayAH । keSagrahAn prahArAMSca SirasyetAni varjjayet ॥ na pARiByAmuBAByAntu kaRqUyAjjAtu vE SiraH ॥” kiYca । “suvAsinIM gurvviRIYca vfdDaM bAlAturO taTA । Bojayet saMskftAnnena praTamaM caramaM gfhI ॥ aGaM sa kevalaM BuNkte badDe govAhanAdike । yo BuNkte pARqavaSrezWa prekzatAmapradAya ca ॥ varjjayeddaDi SaktuYca rAtrO DAnASca vAsare ॥” kiYca । “srajaSca nAvakarzeta na vahirGArayIta ca । gfhe pArAvatA DanyAH SukASca sahakArikAH ॥” kOrmme vyAsagItAyAm । “tfRaM vA yadi vA SAkaM mUlaM vA jalameva vA । parasyApaharan janturnarakaM pratipadyate ॥ na rAjYaH pratigfhRIyAnna SUdrAt patitAdapi । nAnyasmAdyAcakatvaYca ninditAdbarjjayedbuDaH ॥ nityaM yAcanako na syAt punastatrEva yAcayet । prARAnapaharatyeza yAcakastasya durmmatiH ॥ na devadravyahArI syAdbiSezeRa dvijottamAH । brahmasvaYca nApaharedApadyapi kadAcana ॥ na vizaM vizamityAhurbrahmasvaM vizamucyate । devasvaM vApi yatnena sadA pariharettataH ॥ na DarmmasyApadeSena pApaM kftvA vrataM caret । vratena pApaM pracCAdya kurvvan strISUdradamBanam ॥ pretyeha cedfSo vipro garhyeta brahmavAdiBiH । devadrohAdgurudrohaH kowikowiguRADikaH ॥ jYAnApavAdo nAstikyaM tasmAt kowiguRADikam ॥” * ॥ kiYca । “himavadbinDyayormaDye pUrvvapaScimayoH SuBam । muktrA samudrayorddeSaM nAnyatra nivaseddvijaH ॥ kfzRo vA yatra carati mfgo nityaM svaBAvataH । puRyASca viSrutA nadyastatra vA nivaseddvijaH ॥ ardDakroSAnnadIkUlaM varjjayitvA dvijottamAH ॥” kiYca । “agninA BasmanA cEva salilena viSezataH । dvAreRa stamBamArgeRa zaqBiH paNktirvviBidyate ॥ parakzetre carantIM gAM na cAcakzIta kasyacit । na sUryyapariveSaM vA nendracApaM na cAgnikam ॥ parasmE kaTayedbidvAn SaSinaM vA kaTaYcana । tiTiM pakzasya na brU yAnnakzatrARi vinirddiSet ॥ na devaguruviprARAM dIyamAnantu vArayet । nindayedyo gurUn devAn vedaM vA sopabfMhaRam ॥ kalpakowiSataM sAgraM rOrave pacyate naraH । tUzRImAsIta nindAyAM na brUyAt kiYciduttaram ॥ karRO piDAya gantavyaM na cEnamavalokayet । varjjayed vE rahasyaYca parezAM gUhayedbuDaH ॥ vivAdaM svajanEH sArdDaM na kuryyAdvE kadAcana । na pApaM pApinAM brUyAdapApaM vA dvijottamAH ॥ nekzetodyantamAdityaM SaSinaM vAnimittataH । nAstaM yAntaM na vArisTaM nopasfzwaM na maDyagam ॥ tirohitaM vAsasA vA na daSAntaragAminam । nagnAM striyaM pumAMsaM vA purIzaM mUtrameva vA ॥ patitavyaNgacARqAlAnucCizwAnnAvalokayet । na yuktabanDanANgAM vA nonmattaM mattameva vA ॥ spfSenna Bojane patnIM nEnAmIkzeta mehatIm । kzuvantIM jamBamARAM vA nAsanasTAM yaTAsuKam ॥ nodake cAtmano rUpaM na kulaM SvaBrameva vA । na SUdrAya matiM dadyAt kfzaraM pAyasaM daDi ॥ nocCizwaM vA GftamaDu na ca kfzRAjinaM haviH । na kuryyAt kasyacit pIqAM mutaM SizyaYca tAqayet ॥ nAtmAnamavamanyeta dEnyaM yatnena varjjayet । na ca SizyAnna sat kuryyAnnAtmAnaM SaMsayedbuDaH ॥ na nadyAYca nadIM brUyAt parvvatezu na parvvatam । Avasettena nEvApi yastyajet sahavAsinam ॥ Siro'ByaNgAvaSizwena tElenANgaM na lepayet । romARi ca rahasyAni svAni KAni ca na spfSet ॥ na pAnipAdavANnetracApalAni samASrayet । nABihanyAjjalaM padByAM pARinA na kadAcana ॥ na GAtayedizwikABiH PalAni na Palena ca । na mlecCaBAzaRaM Sikzenna karzeSca padAsanam ॥ notsaNge BakzayedBakzyAn gAYca saMveSayenna hi । nAkzEH krIqenna DAveta strIBirvvAdaM na cAcaret ॥ na dantErnaKalomAni CindyAt suptaM na voDayet । na vAlAtapamAsevet pretaDUmaM vivarjjayet ॥ nEkaH supyAt SUnyagfhe svayaM nopAnahO vahet । nAkAraRAdbA nizWIvenna bAhuByAM nadIM taret ॥ na pAdakzAlanaM kuryyAt pAdenEva kadAcana । nAgnO pratApayet pAdO na kAMsye DAvayedbuDaH ॥ nABipratArayeddevAn brAhmaRAn gAmaTApi vA । na spfSet pARinocCizwo vipragobrAhmaRAnalAn ॥ na cEvAnnaM padA vApi na devapratimAM spfSet । nottaredanupaspfSya sravantIM no vyatikramet ॥ cEtyaM vfkzaM nEva CindyAnnApsu zWIvanamutsfjet । na cAgniM laNgayedDImAn nopadaDyAdaDaH kvacit ॥ na cEvaM pAdataH kuryyAt tilabadDaM niSi tyajet । na kUpamavaroheta nAcakzItASuciH kvacit ॥ agno na prakzipedagniM nAdBiH praSamayettaTA । suhfnmaraRamArttiM vA na svayaM SrAvayet parAn ॥ apaRyamaTa paRyaM vA vikrayaM na prayojayet । puRyasTAnodakasTAne sImAntaM vA kfzenna tu ॥ na BindyAt pUrvvasamayaM satyopetaM kadAcana । parasparaM paSUn vyAlAn pakziRo na ca yoDayet ॥ kArayitvA svakarmmARi kArUn vidvAn na vaYcayet । vahirganDaYca kudvArapraveSaYca vivarjjayet ॥ nEkaScaret saBAM vipraH samavAyaYca varjjayet । na bIjayedvA vastreRa na devAyatane svapet । nAgnigobrAhmaRAdInAmantareRa vrajet kvacit । nAkrAmet kAmataSCAyAM brAhmaRAnAM gavAmapi ॥ svAntu nAkrAmayecCAyAM patitAdyErnarogiBiH । varjayenmArjanIreRuM vastrasnAnaGawodakam ॥ nASnIyAt payasA takraM na bIjAnyupavIjayet ॥ vivatsAyASca gokzIramOzwraM vA nirddaSasya ca । AvikaM sanDinIkzIramapeyaM manurabravIt ॥ hantakAramaTAgryaM vA BikzAM vA Saktito dvijaH । dadyAdatiTaye nityaM buDyeta parameSvaram ॥ BikzAmAhurgrAsamAtramagryaM tasmAccaturguRam । puzkalaM hantakArantu taccaturguRamizyate ॥” mArkaRqeye । “BojanaM hantakAraM vA agryaM BikzAmaTApi vA । adattvA tu na BoktavyaM yaTA viBavamAtmanaH ॥” * kASIKaRqe । “nEvotkawAsane'SnIyAnnAgnO vastvaSuci kzipet ॥ SrAdDaM kftvA paraSrAdDe yo'SrIyAt jYAnavarjitaH । dAtuH SrAdDaPalaM nAsti BoktA kilvizaBugBavet ॥ notpAwayellomanaKaM daSanena kadAcana । karajEH karajacCedaM kareREva vivarjjayet ॥ apadvAre na gantavyaM svaveSmaparaveSmanoH । utkocadyUtadevArTadravyaM dUrAt parityajet ॥ nizWIvanaYca SlezmARaM gfhAt dUre viniHkzipet ॥ udDftya paYcamftpiRqAn snAyAt parajalASaye । anudDftya ca tatkartturenasaH syAtturIyaBAk ॥” brAhme । “yastu pARitale BuNkte yastu PatkArasaMyutam । prasftANguliBiryastu tasya gomAMsavacca tat ॥” atrismftO । “nyUnADikastanI yA gOryATavABakzacAriRI । tayordugDaM na hotavyaM na pAtavyaM kadAcana ॥ ajA gAvo mahizyaSca yAmeDyamapi Bakzayet । havye kavye ca taddugDaM gomayaYca vivarjjayet ॥ aNgulyA dantakAzWaYca pratyakzalavaRantaTA । mfttikAprASanaYcEva tulyaM gomAMsaBakzaREH ॥” atrApavAdo manusmftO । “sAmudraM sEnDavaYcEva lavaRe paramAdBute । pratyakze api te grAhye nizeDastvanyagocaraH ॥” atrismftO । “divA kapitTacCAyA ca niSAyAM daDiBojanam । kArpAsaM dantakAzWaYca SakrAdapi haret Sriyam ॥” vizRusmftO ca । “kapilAyAH payaH pItvA SUdrastu narakaM vrajet । homaSezaM pibedbipro vipraH syAdanyaTA paSuH ॥ pariharttuM punarleKaM tattacCAstroktamanyaTA । yadatra liKitaM kiYcittat kzantavyaM mahAtmaBiH ॥ AcArAScedfSAH santi pare'pi bahulAH satAm । te lokaSAstrato jYeyA apekzyA yadi vEzRavEH ॥ nityatvamezAM mAhAtmyamapyatra liKitAt purA । sadAcArasyanityatvAnmAhAtmyAcca susidDyati ॥” iti SrIhariBaktivilAse tityakftyasamApano nAma 11 vilAsaH ॥
m: वैष्णवाचार m. the rites or practices of the Vaiṣṇavas

s: klI, (vEzRavasyAcamanam .) vizRupUjAdipUrvvakarttavyakarttfsaM skArakANga--o~kArAdinamo'ntacaturTyantatattannAmoccAraRapUrvvakatrirjjalapAnAdi । yaTA, -- “triHpAne keSavaM nArAyaRaM mADavamapyaTa । prakzalane dbayoH pARyorgovindaM vizRumapyuBO ॥ maDusUdanamekaYca mArjjane'nyaM trivikramam । unmArjjane'pyaDarayorvvAmanaSrIDarAvuBO ॥ prakzAlane punaH pARyorhfzIkeSaYca pAdayoH । padmanAmaM prokzaRe tu mUrdDni dAmodaraM tataH ॥ vAsudevaM muKe saNkarzaRaM pradyumnamityuBO । nAsayornetrayugale'nirudDaM puruzottamam ॥ aDokzajaM nfsiMhaYca karRayornABito'cyutam । janArddanaYca hfdaye upendraM mastake tataH ॥ dakziRe tu hariM bAhO vAme kfzRaM yaTAviDi । namo'ntaYca caturTyantamAcAmet kramato japan ॥ aSaktaH kevalaM dakzaM spfSet karRaM taTA ca vAk ॥ kurvvItAlaBanaM vApi dakziRaSravaRasya vE ॥” taTA ca vAk iti yatastaTEva vacanamasti । kurvvItAlaBanaM vApIti mArkaRqeyapurARavacanamato na pOnaruktam । iti SrIhariBaktivilAse 3 vilAsaH ॥
m: वैष्णवाचमन n. sipping water three times in the worship of Viṣṇu, MW.
वैष्णवायन m. patr. fr. वैष्णव, g. हरितादि.

s: strI, (vizRoriyam । vizRu + aR । striyAM NIp .) vizRuSaktiH । yaTA, -- “ezA triSaktiruddizwA nayasidDAntagAminI । ezA SvetA parA sfzwiH sAttvikI brahmasaMhitA ॥ ezEva kfzRA tamasi rOdrI devI prakIrttitA ॥ azwAdaSa yaTA kowyo vEzRavyA Beda ucyate । yA vizRo rAjasI SaktiH pAlinI cEva vEzRavI ॥” iti vArAhe triSaktimAhAtmyanAmADyAyaH ॥ api ca । “SaNKacakragadADArI vizRumAtA taTArihA । vizRurUpATavA devI vEzRavI tena gIyate ॥” iti devIpurARe 45 aDyAyaH ॥ aparaYca । “vizRuBaktA vizRurUpA vizRoH SaktisvarUpiRI । sfzwO ca vizRunA sfzwA vEzRavI tena kIrttitA ॥” iti brahmavEvartte prakftiKaRqe 54 aDyAyaH ॥ durgA । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ gaNgA । yaTA, padmapurARam । “vizRoH pAdaprasUtAsi vEzRavI vizRupUjitA । pAhi nastvenasastasmAdAjanmamaraRAntikAt ॥” ityAdi AhrikAcAratattve snAnArTagaNgAvAhanamantraH ॥ anyacca । “vizRupAdaprasUtAsi vEzRavInAmaDAriRI । sarvvatra rakza mAM nityaM gaNgA tripaTagAminI ॥” iti gaNgAkavacam ॥ aparAjitA । iti SabdacandrikA ॥ SatAvarI । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ tulasI । iti SabdamAlA ॥
m: वैष्णवी (ई), f. patr. fr. विष्णु, MBh.
a female worshipper of Viṣṇu, Pañcar.
the personified Śakti of Viṣṇu (regarded as one of the Mātṛs, and identified with Durgā and Manasā), MBh.; Rājat. &c.

k.v: कपर्दोऽस्य जटाजूटः पिनाकोऽजगवं धनुः। प्रमथा: स्युः पारिषदा ब्राह्मी इत्याद्यास्तु मातरः। ब्राह्मी माहेश्वरी चैव कौमारी वैष्णवी तथा। वारीही च तथेन्द्राणी चामुण्डा सप्तमातरः॥

m: वैष्णव mf(ई)n. relating or belonging or devoted or consecrated to Viṣṇu (q.v.), worshipping V˚, TS. &c. &c.
वैष्णव m. patr. fr. विष्णु, g. बिदादि

‘a worshipper of V˚’, N. of one of the three great divisions of modern Hindūism (the other two being the Śaivas and Śāktas; the Vaiṣṇavas identify Viṣṇu — rather than Brahmā and Śiva — with the supreme Being, and are exclusively devoted to his worship; they have become separated into four principal and some minor sects, as follow: 1. the Rāmānujas, founded by Rāmānuja, who is said to have lived for 120 years [from 1017 till 1137 A.D.] ; his chief doctrines are described at p. 878, col. 1, and in RTL. p. 119 &c.; one peculiarity of his sect is the scrupulous preparation and privacy of three meals; 2. the Mādhvas, founded by a Kanarese Brāhman named Madhva, whose chief doctrines are described at p. 782, col. 3, and in RTL. p. 130 &c.; 3. the Vallabhas, founded by Vallabhācārya, whose chief doctrines are described at p. 928, col. 3, and in RTL. p. 134 &c.; 4. a sect in Bengal founded by Caitanya [q.v.] who was regarded by his followers as an incarnation of Kṛṣṇa; his chief doctrine was the duty of भक्ति, or love for that god which was to be so strong that no caste-feelings could exist with it [see, RTL. p. 140 &c.] Of the minor Vaiṣṇava sects those founded by Nimbārka or Nimbāditya [RTL. 146] and by Rāmānanda [RTL. 147] and by Svāmi-Nārāyaṇa [RTL. 148] are perhaps the most important, to which also may be added the reformed theistic sect founded by Kabīr [RTL. 158] and the Sikh theistic sect founded by Nānak [RTL. 161])
N. of Soma (lord of the Apsarasas), ĀśvŚr.
the 13th cubit (अरत्नि) from the bottom or the 5th from the top of the sacrificial post, L.
(scil. यज्ञ) a partic. sacrificial ceremony, ib.
वैष्णव n. a partic. Mahā-rasa (q.v.), Cat.
a partic. prodigy or omen (belonging to or occurring in the परं दिवम् or upper sky), MW.
the ashes of a burnt-offering, ib.
N. of the NakṣatraŚravaṇa (presided over by Viṣṇu), VarBṛS.
of various works., esp. of the Viṣṇu-Purāṇa
